requirements.information_requirement: Retain product UIN separately from immutable terms revision and original hash. Record the policy event that selects the revision and the scope of each amendment.
requirements.observed_reason: Regulatory revisions can retain the UIN. Acquisition date alone cannot select terms for an old claim.

requirements.information_requirement: Preserve table selector, column value, units, procedure row, variant and connected footnote.
requirements.observed_reason: The Silver procedure table uses the deductible as its selector; Gold uses sum insured. Both are INR amounts but have different meanings.

requirements.information_requirement: Distinguish fixed money, a dependent limit, unlimited, zero, unknown and not applicable.
requirements.observed_reason: Some Gold modern-treatment rows say up to sum insured, a finite bound. The New India CIS describes its deductible as not applicable.

requirements.information_requirement: Track expense admissibility and accumulation by episode, policy year and covered members, with prior usage and the revisions that established it.
requirements.observed_reason: Two claims in different top-up years cannot be combined merely because they share an employer policy year.

requirements.information_requirement: Separate gross expenses, admitted amounts, threshold consumption, insurer payments and unpaid eligible balances.
requirements.observed_reason: A standalone excess of INR500000 is not the final payment when only INR400000 of an INR800000 loss remains unpaid.

requirements.information_requirement: Retain credited cover layers with their inception and enhancement dates, continuity and waiting-period type.
requirements.observed_reason: Moratorium, PED lookback and prospective waiting periods use different clocks. An increased amount does not inherit every credit of the original amount.

requirements.information_requirement: Retain the literal comparison operator, cutoff, triggering event, applicable timezone and any unassigned boundary.
requirements.observed_reason: The72-hour information clock and five-day decision clock start at different receipts. Before/after wording can leave the exact cutoff unassigned.

requirements.information_requirement: Separate policy term, annual renewal, instalment due dates, continuity protection, claim cover and accelerated premium debt.
requirements.observed_reason: A delay can protect continuity without covering an admission during unpaid renewal; within-term instalment grace has a different cover rule.

requirements.information_requirement: Retain conflicting assertions, printed cross-references, reviewed destinations, express precedence and unresolved dependencies.
requirements.observed_reason: Agreement between a CIS and one wording clause does not settle a contradiction elsewhere in the wording. Incorrect printed references still need to be preserved.

requirements.information_requirement: Retrieve image and table regions, physical and printed page identities, headers, footnotes and language alongside text.
requirements.observed_reason: Text extraction missed23 HDFC product/UIN rows. The Gold table continues across rotated regions on two pages.

requirements.information_requirement: Retain exact provider branch, dated network and exclusion status, authorization events, clinical stabilization and time-attributed expenses.
requirements.observed_reason: An excluded-provider emergency exception stops at stabilization. Being outside a network is a separate status.

requirements.information_requirement: Separate insurer-wide availability duties, product eligibility, proposal, underwriting offer, acceptance and commencement.
requirements.observed_reason: A requirement to offer choices does not mean one product covers everyone or that a port application has been accepted.

requirements.information_requirement: Attribute each assertion to its person, original utterance, unit, language and turn. Link corrections to superseded assertions and distinguish unknown from reported negative facts.
requirements.observed_reason: A35-year-old buyer and70-year-old mother are separate subjects. Father-positive and buyer-negative diabetes statements must remain separate.

requirements.information_requirement: Bind saved decisions and worker inputs to explicit fact and corpus revisions. Persist durable, idempotent events and invalidate obsolete results.
requirements.observed_reason: A worker that finishes last must not overwrite a customer correction. Reconnecting should replay saved work.

requirements.information_requirement: Check conversation ownership and explicit context-reuse preferences before retrieval. Deletion must reach derived copies, queued payloads and decisions, with status for each affected store.
requirements.observed_reason: Owning both conversations does not override a no-reuse request. A stale index or worker must not recreate a deleted fact.

requirements.information_requirement: Record authoring, original reading, scoped reference assessment, full customer decision and executed adviser attempt as distinct completion states.
requirements.observed_reason: A correct hypothetical threshold calculation cannot count as a successful independent adviser attempt.

status: Evidence-derived requirements, not proposed database entities or fields
